history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A digitally illustrated, anime-inspired character of a young woman with large, expressive, sparkling eyes and long, wavy, dark brown hair. She is wearing a stylish, textured, red tweed jacket and skirt set with silver button details. A small, light beige handbag with a gold chain strap and a triangular logo is slung over her left shoulder. Her pose is seated, with her hands resting on her knees and her legs crossed.
